title: Doesn’t work for me...
text: Doesn’t work for me.... Once every five years I have to try a down pillow just to see if it will work for my sore neck - and it never works.  This is a high quality pillow - probably filled with top quality down feathers, but, for me, it goes flat after a couple hours, and I spend the rest of the night trying to plump it up enough to support my neck.  This is probably great for many people - it just doesn’t work for me!

Choosing a down pillowFor the perfect slumber, we all have slightly different bed pillow preferences, often linked to sleeping style. Stomach sleepers may prefer soft pillows, which cushion the neck as the head sinks to the perfect level. Back sleepers should choose a medium density to support the natural curvature of the spine, while side sleepers require a firm pillow for perfect nocturnal alignment.
